title: Reorg, Rebase, and the 2026 Credit Bomb
script_summary:
**BITCOIN BRIEF**

Foundry just erased two blocks from competing pools at height 941,880—a power move that happens once every 150,000 blocks. They're commanding 30 percent of global hashrate, and what looks like luck is actually dominance. That's your mining consolidation story.

But the real pressure is macro. Private credit is building toward a 2026 bond issuance bomb—the largest year on record. When defaults cascade, they break the lender's capacity to lend. That's contagion. Bitcoin at 66,41
